geography: New Providence as share of All Bahamas
definition: Nearly three in four residents live on one island. New Providence: 296,732 people out of 398,165 nationally.

indicator: Internet access and the age gap
definition: Access among people aged 65+ was 80.4%. The national figure was 64.7% in 2010. These are people with access, not households or broadband subscriptions.
